description: Batch: up to 10 blocks in one call. Batch block lookup: latest block plus up to 10 block numbers (comma-separated) on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism in one paid call. Same fields as /v1/evm/block (number, hash, timestamp, tx count, gas, base fee). Costs less than 10 single calls. Deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"chain":"base","latest":1,"blocks":[{"number":1,"hash":"0x…","timestamp":1700000000,"iso":"2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z","txCount":100,"gasUsed":"1","gasLimit":"1","baseFeeGwei":"0.01"}]}. Price: $0.003 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).

numbers.description: Comma-separated block numbers (max 10). Omit for latest only.

name: evm_blocks
